identity_control: Coefficient and residual vectors bitwise match the original fitter in both c arms at all saved baseline endpoints.
qualification: Known-phase-alone controls pass all original curved and predictive residual gates in all 20 templates and both c arms. Some other oracle controls fail stochastic gates; report all errors and counts without removing these cases.
interpretation: Phase knowledge is the highest-value single correction in this fixed synthetic cohort. Knowing receiver constants and linear drift alone cannot achieve the target. This does not prove that real phases can be learned to this precision, and it is not an operational algorithm or a real-data accuracy improvement.
next_action: Test whether score-weighted integration over position improves on a single marginal-score minimum using unchanged causal priors and RF evidence. Start with a bounded, numerically qualified synthetic comparison; do not mistake oracle results for usable phase knowledge or reuse previously rejected prior shrinkage as a new solution.
